description: Reject reversed historical date bounds without silently changing the requested range.
prompt: Prepare a historical backfill of group_bys.gcp.purchases.v1_dev with start date 2025-01-17 and end date 2025-01-10. Inspect the repository if needed, but do not edit files or submit anything. Tell me whether this is ready to run.

judge_criteria: The agent explicitly identifies that the end date precedes the start date and says the request is not ready to submit.
The agent asks for corrected date bounds; it does not silently swap the dates or present an executable command as if a corrected interval were confirmed.
The response stays focused on the date problem and avoids unrelated config-authoring questions.
The agent does not edit repository files, submit jobs, or claim live validation; it answers using the supplied facts and repository evidence.
